final: WITH event_budgets AS (SELECT e.event_name, b.amount FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL), per_event_averages AS (SELECT event_name, AVG(amount) as avg_amount FROM event_budgets GROUP BY event_name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_average FROM per_event_averages), filtered_events AS (SELECT pea.event_name, pea.avg_amount FROM per_event_averages pea CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE pea.avg_amount > oa.overall_average) SELECT fe.event_name, fe.avg_amount, fe.avg_amount - oa.overall_average, fe.avg_amount / oa.overall_average FROM filtered_events fe CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY fe.event_name
